## Releases

Tags `v0.1.0` (Phase 0) and `v0.2.0` (Phase 1) should appear under **Releases**.
If a tag exists without a Release, click **Draft a release** → choose the tag → publish using notes in `docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md`.
